title: Marketplace Channel Integration Platform Competitive Landscape

scope.description: Vendors competing with EffectConnect for merchant and brand budgets to connect webshops and back offices to European marketplaces and product feed channels, with focus on the Benelux.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: marketplace integrators and feed-management platforms that EffectConnect's Benelux customers would shortlist, including global enterprise integrators (Rithum, Feedonomics) that larger Benelux brands and retailers evaluate. Excluded: marketplaces' own seller tools, pure repricing tools and agencies; Katapull sibling brands; back-office systems with their own marketplace connectors (these are partners or channels).
scope.notes: Figures are company-reported and carry each company's own scope; they are not comparable with each other or with EffectConnect's own claims (50+ European marketplaces). Where no reliable figure was found, no stat is listed.

players.name: ChannelEngine
players.description: Global marketplace integration platform for brands and retailers; acquired Leiden-based Vendiro (70+ marketplaces) in June 2023, consolidating the Dutch integrator market. Main head-to-head competitor in the Benelux.

players.name: Channable
players.description: Feed management and marketplace integration platform for webshops and agencies, strong in product feeds for Google, Meta and comparison sites and expanding into marketplace order connections; acquired Danish feed-management company WakeupData in June 2024. Competes with EffectConnect's Feed Manager and marketplace offering.

businessStats.scope: offices in the Netherlands, Berlin and New York City, at time of WakeupData acquisition
businessStats.sourceTitle: Nederlands multichannel-platform Channable neemt Deense speler WakeupData over (press release)

businessStats.value: 2,500+ digital marketplaces, ad platforms and comparison sites
businessStats.sourceTitle: Nederlands multichannel-platform Channable neemt Deense speler WakeupData over (press release)

players.name: Lengow
players.description: European e-commerce automation platform combining feed management for advertising channels with marketplace integration.

players.name: Tradebyte
players.description: Zalando-owned commerce platform connecting fashion and lifestyle brands with marketplaces and retailers in DACH and Europe; relevant for brands selling on Zalando and fashion marketplaces.

players.name: Productsup
players.description: Product-to-consumer (P2C) data platform for feed and marketplace syndication, aimed at larger brands and retailers; overlaps with EffectConnect at the upper end and with brands.

businessStats.value: over two trillion products per month

players.name: Koongo
players.description: Feed and marketplace integration service for SME webshops, also offering a Logic4 connection, which makes it an alternative for Katapull back-office customers.

players.name: Rithum (ChannelAdvisor)
players.description: Enterprise multichannel commerce platform formed from the merger of ChannelAdvisor and CommerceHub; connects brands and retailers to marketplaces, retail drop-ship and digital advertising. Competes with EffectConnect for larger Benelux brands and retailers selling across European marketplaces.

businessStats.value: over 40,000 global brands, suppliers, and retailers
more than $50 billion in annual GMV
businessStats.scope: GMV powered across the platform, company-reported

players.name: Feedonomics
players.description: Full-service product feed optimisation and syndication platform for ad channels and marketplaces, run as an independent business unit of BigCommerce (now Commerce) since 2021. Competes with EffectConnect's Feed Manager and marketplace listings for larger brands and retailers.

businessStats.value: 2,000+ destinations across ad channels, marketplaces, and AI surfaces
up to approximately $145 million (about $80 million in cash at closing)
businessStats.sourceTitle: BigCommerce Invests in Becoming World's Most Powerful Platform for Global Omnichannel Commerce with Acquisition of Feedonomics
